title: Metrics summary — host summaries
description: Metric summary counters/distributions with nine flat labels; adaptive, total-point-budgeted time buckets and observed gauge summaries.

list.name: host
list.label: Host

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT hex(host) AS value, host AS text FROM (
SELECT host FROM metrics_summary.distributions WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
UNION ALL
SELECT host FROM metrics_summary.counters WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
) ORDER BY host LIMIT 10000

options.content:
Choose a host and separate metric names for Counter increments and Gauge current values: both are stored in counters, without a type marker. Distribution panels assume nanosecond input. **Local-window p99 mean/worst are not a global percentile.** Counter rates are stored increments summed in adaptive buckets (at least 10 seconds) / actual bucket width; they are not per-collection rates. Timestamp precision is one second. Gauge panels show observed mean/range rather than an exact latest value. Repeated stored rows are counted; there is no storage deduplication or source-session identity.

All time-series panels retain the complete metric + nine-label identity and share a 50,000 numeric point budget per query. More selected series widen the buckets; Gauge mean/min/max count as three points. Queries fail explicitly if even one point per series would exceed the budget. Narrow filters for finer resolution.

panels.title: Exported histogram samples per bucket
panels.description: Sum of the count field in stored distribution rows; repeated inserts are counted again. Adaptive buckets retain all selected series within a 50,000 total numeric point budget (three values per Gauge series).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    50000 AS max_points,
    1 AS value_columns,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__fromTime_ms) AS range_start_ms,
    greatest(toInt64(0), toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - range_start_ms) AS range_span_ms,
    (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io))
FROM metrics_summary.distributions
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${metric:sqlstring}])) AS series_count,
    greatest(toUInt64(1), intDiv(max_points, greatest(series_count * value_columns, toUInt64(1)))) AS buckets_per_series,
    greatest(toInt64(10), intDiv(toInt64($__interval_ms) + 999, 1000),
             intDiv(range_span_ms, toInt64(buckets_per_series) * 1000) + 1)
        + throwIf(series_count * value_columns > max_points,
                  'Selected series exceed the 50000 point budget; narrow host, metric, or time filters') AS bucket_seconds
SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(range_start_ms +
       intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toDateTime64(TIMESTAMP, 3)) - range_start_ms, bucket_seconds * 1000)
       * bucket_seconds * 1000) AS time,
       toJSONString(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io)) AS series,
       sum(count) AS samples
FROM metrics_summary.distributions
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY time, metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
QUALIFY throwIf(count() OVER () * value_columns > max_points,
                'Selected series changed during the query and exceed the point budget; narrow filters or retry') = 0
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Sample-weighted mean
panels.description: Weighted across stored distributions: sum(mean * count) / sum(count). Repeated inserts are included. Adaptive buckets retain all selected series within a 50,000 total numeric point budget (three values per Gauge series).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    50000 AS max_points,
    1 AS value_columns,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__fromTime_ms) AS range_start_ms,
    greatest(toInt64(0), toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - range_start_ms) AS range_span_ms,
    (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io))
FROM metrics_summary.distributions
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${metric:sqlstring}])) AS series_count,
    greatest(toUInt64(1), intDiv(max_points, greatest(series_count * value_columns, toUInt64(1)))) AS buckets_per_series,
    greatest(toInt64(10), intDiv(toInt64($__interval_ms) + 999, 1000),
             intDiv(range_span_ms, toInt64(buckets_per_series) * 1000) + 1)
        + throwIf(series_count * value_columns > max_points,
                  'Selected series exceed the 50000 point budget; narrow host, metric, or time filters') AS bucket_seconds
SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(range_start_ms +
       intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toDateTime64(TIMESTAMP, 3)) - range_start_ms, bucket_seconds * 1000)
       * bucket_seconds * 1000) AS time,
       toJSONString(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io)) AS series,
       sum(mean * count) / nullIf(sum(count), 0) AS weighted_mean
FROM metrics_summary.distributions
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY time, metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
QUALIFY throwIf(count() OVER () * value_columns > max_points,
                'Selected series changed during the query and exceed the point budget; narrow filters or retry') = 0
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Distribution observations and local p95
panels.description: Missing rows mean no exported observations, not a zero measurement.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io, count() AS stored_rows, sum(count) AS samples,
       min(min) AS observed_min, max(max) AS observed_max,
       avg(p95) AS mean_local_window_p95, max(p95) AS worst_local_window_p95,
       max(TIMESTAMP) AS last_observed
FROM metrics_summary.distributions
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
ORDER BY metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io

panels.title: Counter observed rate per adaptive bucket
panels.description: For Counter metric names only: sum of stored increments divided by the actual adaptive bucket width. Bucket width is at least 10s and the Grafana interval, and grows to keep all selected series within 50,000 total numeric points. Partial range-edge buckets may be incomplete; repeated writes increase the sum.

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    50000 AS max_points,
    1 AS value_columns,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__fromTime_ms) AS range_start_ms,
    greatest(toInt64(0), toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - range_start_ms) AS range_span_ms,
    (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io))
FROM metrics_summary.counters
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${counter_metric:sqlstring}])) AS series_count,
    greatest(toUInt64(1), intDiv(max_points, greatest(series_count * value_columns, toUInt64(1)))) AS buckets_per_series,
    greatest(toInt64(10), intDiv(toInt64($__interval_ms) + 999, 1000),
             intDiv(range_span_ms, toInt64(buckets_per_series) * 1000) + 1)
        + throwIf(series_count * value_columns > max_points,
                  'Selected series exceed the 50000 point budget; narrow host, metric, or time filters') AS bucket_seconds
SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(range_start_ms +
       intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toDateTime64(TIMESTAMP, 3)) - range_start_ms, bucket_seconds * 1000)
       * bucket_seconds * 1000) AS time,
       toJSONString(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io)) AS series,
       sum(toFloat64(val)) / toFloat64(bucket_seconds) AS observed_rate_per_second
FROM metrics_summary.counters
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${counter_metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY time, metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
QUALIFY throwIf(count() OVER () * value_columns > max_points,
                'Selected series changed during the query and exceed the point budget; narrow filters or retry') = 0
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Gauge observed mean and range per bucket
panels.description: For Gauge metric names only. Aggregates stored snapshots in each bucket. Same-second values have no stored ordering, and no exact latest value is inferred. Adaptive buckets retain all selected series within a 50,000 total numeric point budget (three values per Gauge series).

targets.rawSql:
WITH
    50000 AS max_points,
    3 AS value_columns,
    toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__fromTime_ms) AS range_start_ms,
    greatest(toInt64(0), toUnixTimestamp64Milli($__toTime_ms) - range_start_ms) AS range_span_ms,
    (SELECT uniqExact(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io))
FROM metrics_summary.counters
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${gauge_metric:sqlstring}])) AS series_count,
    greatest(toUInt64(1), intDiv(max_points, greatest(series_count * value_columns, toUInt64(1)))) AS buckets_per_series,
    greatest(toInt64(10), intDiv(toInt64($__interval_ms) + 999, 1000),
             intDiv(range_span_ms, toInt64(buckets_per_series) * 1000) + 1)
        + throwIf(series_count * value_columns > max_points,
                  'Selected series exceed the 50000 point budget; narrow host, metric, or time filters') AS bucket_seconds
SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Milli(range_start_ms +
       intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(toDateTime64(TIMESTAMP, 3)) - range_start_ms, bucket_seconds * 1000)
       * bucket_seconds * 1000) AS time,
       toJSONString(tuple(metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io)) AS series,
       avg(val) AS observed_mean, min(val) AS observed_min, max(val) AS observed_max
FROM metrics_summary.counters
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${gauge_metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY time, metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
QUALIFY throwIf(count() OVER () * value_columns > max_points,
                'Selected series changed during the query and exceed the point budget; narrow filters or retry') = 0
ORDER BY time, series

panels.title: Gauge observed range by labels
panels.description: Observed range over the selected period. last_observed indicates freshness, not a uniquely ordered latest value.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io, count() AS stored_rows,
       avg(val) AS observed_mean, min(val) AS observed_min, max(val) AS observed_max,
       max(TIMESTAMP) AS last_observed
FROM metrics_summary.counters
WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(TIMESTAMP)
  AND host IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${host:sqlstring}])
  AND metricName IN arrayMap(value -> unhex(value), [${gauge_metric:sqlstring}])
GROUP BY metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
ORDER BY metricName, host, pod, instance, tag, thread, uid, statusCode, mount_name, io
